Scenario:

A train 500 m long crosses a man running at 9 km/h in the same direction in 30 seconds. How long does the train take to cross a platform 300 m long while travelling at the same speed?

Scenario:

II. No river is a desert.

II. Some vehicles are heavy.

Which conclusions definitely follow?
